findings.current: If even one item is damaged, I’ll have your head!
findings.defect: The official threatens punishment, not execution.
findings.rationale: 경을 치다 means to be punished or get into serious trouble; it does not specify beheading.
findings.replacement: If even one item is damaged, you’ll pay for it!
findings.source: 만약 하나라도 상한 물건이 있다면 내 경을 칠 것이다!

findings.current: Your head’s as empty as a rock, so I’ll give you a simple example.
findings.defect: “Empty” reverses the image of a solid stone head and weakens the later joke about breaking stone.
findings.rationale: 속이 꽉 찬 돌 describes a rock solid all the way through, setting up his threat to break a stone head.
findings.replacement: Your head’s as solid as a rock, so I’ll give you a simple example.
findings.source: 네 녀석의 대가리는 속이 꽉 찬 돌과 진배없으니 간단히 예를 들어 주마.

findings.defect: The response softens explicit profanity and loses some of Taekyung’s bluntness.
findings.rationale: 좆 같죠 is strongly profane; the abrupt complaint about his interrupted meal is the joke.
findings.replacement: *“That’d be fucking awful. I’m trying to eat.”*

findings.current: The old man’s eyes gleamed sharply, as though he’d never said a thing like that. I gave him a brief answer.
findings.defect: “Never said a thing like that” assigns the contrast to his words rather than his sudden change from a deferential laborer.
findings.rationale: 언제 그랬냐는 듯 marks how abruptly his bearing changes; the source does not retract anything he said.
findings.replacement: The old man’s eyes gleamed fiercely, as if he’d never played the humble laborer. I gave him a brief answer.
findings.source: 언제 그랬냐는 듯, 형형한 안광을 빛내는 초로인을 향해 나는 짤막하게 답했다.

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it changes a threat of punishment into a death threat, reverses a joke’s image, and softens one profane response.
